response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile staff-level engineer with a strong generalist background (15+ years, full-stack, DevOps, TDD), but he lacks the core requirement of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions. His only AI/agentic experience is a few months at re:cinq working on MCP tooling, with no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, AI data pipelines, or cloud-native AI system design that the role explicitly requires.
strengths: Extensive staff/senior-level engineering experience across many languages and domains
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic developer tooling, aligning with a listed key technology
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source project ownership
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of AI-specific solution development; AI exposure appears limited to a few recent months
No mention of vector databases, RAG pipelines, or LLM evaluation/optimization experience
No evidence of customer-facing technical discovery leadership or cloud-native AI system architecture work

key_factors.factor: Lack of 8+ years AI solution development
